parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the IP Camera

parameters.name: valueX
parameters.description: Movement in X direction. If not specified, it's assumed to be zero. Valid ranges between -1.0f and 1.0f for all movements

parameters.name: valueY
parameters.description: Movement in Y direction. If not specified, it's assumed to be zero. Valid ranges between -1.0f and 1.0f for all movements

parameters.name: valueZ
parameters.description: Movement in Zoom. If not specified, it's assumed to be zero. Valid ranges for relative and continous move is between -1.0f and 1.0f. For absolute move between 0.0f and 1.0f

parameters.name: movement
parameters.description: Movement type. It can be absolute, relative or continuous. If not specified, it's relative
